subject: Reranker integration + evaluation follow-up
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acmeinsights.com>, Ashley Green <ashley@acmeinsights.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Reranker integration + evaluation follow-up

Thanks again for your time this morning — great discussion. Quick recap and next steps so we’re aligned: 

- Goal: integrate a reranker on top of embeddings to improve relevance for Acme Insights’ internal search and recommendations.
- Success metrics discussed: Precision@K, NDCG@10, and latency SLO of <= 120ms p95 for the reranker path.
- Infra constraints: current workspace runs on AWS us-west-2, ~50k documents initially (PDF/text), target to scale to 1M over Q3.

Technical questions we’d like to confirm before the evaluation run:
1) Ranking API: do you want Redwood’s dedicated reranker endpoint (embedding + rerank in one call) or a two-step pipeline (embed -> store -> rerank via top_k)? Which fits your infra/security needs?
2) Top_k tuning: what’s your current expected k for downstream UX (top 5, 10?) — we’ll propose default experiments for top_k in {5,10,20}.
3) Relevance labels: can you share the evaluation set (queries + labeled relevant doc ids)? A small seed (~500 queries) is fine to start.
4) Embedding model: which model are you currently using? (We recommended text-embedding-3-small for cost; we can evaluate multiple.)
5) Auth & routing: will you use our hosted API or Dedicated? We need IP allowlist / API key plan to set up secure routing.

Attachments: I’ve attached a short evaluation plan and sample payloads for Redwood’s SDK.

Next steps: Samir to share labels & dataset link; Dev/ Priyom and I will propose an evaluation matrix and a short runbook for integration. Suggest a follow-up tech call Thurs to review the evaluation plan.

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
(415) 555-0123
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acmeinsights.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Ashley Green <ashley@acmeinsights.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2026 13:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Reranker integration + evaluation follow-up

Marissa — thanks for the summary. That matches our thinking. Quick answers inline: 

1) Ranking API: prefer a two-step pipeline (embed -> store -> rerank) for now so we can keep the index decoupled from reranker experiments.
2) Top_k: our product currently surfaces top 5, but we want to test up to top 20 for analytics.
3) Relevance labels: attaching a CSV with 600 labeled queries (query_id, query_text, relevant_doc_ids). Also shared an S3 link to full candidate set.
4) Embedding model: currently on a small internal model; open to using your text-embedding-3-small for baseline.
5) Auth & routing: prefer Dedicated for data isolation. We’ll need an onboarding doc for IP allowlist and API key rotation process.

Attaching: labels.csv, sample_payloads.json (contains example embed + rerank payloads). Also dropping the S3 folder link in case that helps.

—Samir
Samir Patel
Head of Search, Acme Insights
samir.patel@acmeinsights.com
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acmeinsights.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2026 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Reranker integration + evaluation follow-up

Thanks Samir — got the labels and S3 link. A couple technical notes from the reranker/runtime side: 

- Two-step pipeline is straightforward and gives you more flexibility to swap reranker models without reindexing embeddings. We’ll provide a sample Redwood SDK flow for batching embed calls, storing vectors, and issuing rerank requests.
- Latency: if you want p95 <= 120ms for reranker, we should target top_k <= 20 and use a warmed KV-cache + batching. For top_k experiments I recommend starting with top_k candidates = 100 from ANN retrieval and then rerank top_k in {5,10,20} — that gives a good precision/latency trade-off.
- Relevance metrics: we’ll compute Precision@5/10, Recall@10, and NDCG@10 for the runs. Please confirm which metric is primary; we can optimize for NDCG by tuning training/fine-tune weights or boosting signals in the reranker.
- Eval data: the CSV looks good. Please include the canonical doc ids used in your index and a brief mapping file if doc ids differ between the S3 export and your live index.

I’ve attached a short eval plan template (reranker_evaluation_plan.xlsx) and a sample script for running a baseline evaluation using Redwood’s SDK.

—Dev
Senior Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
dev_patel@redwood.com

Thanks Dev — that all looks sensible. A few clarifications: 

- Primary metric: NDCG@10 (we care about rank quality more than raw precision for the UX).
- Candidate retrieval: we can return 200 ANN candidates to start; feel free to downsample during experiments.
- Doc id mapping: included mapping.csv in the shared folder — doc ids in labels.csv match the mapping.
- Dedicated onboarding: we’ll open a ticket with Infra to get the IP ranges; also want to confirm support window for initial runs.

Schedule: Thurs 18 Mar at 10am PT would work for a tech review — can you send a calendar invite?

—Samir
